reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by web.dev (https://web.dev/).
Technology stack: css, javascript.
Component specification: 最后开无障碍课欢迎文。定义 a11y，作者和 WCAG 链接都在。

Visual details from source observation: 我们进首页，蓝条写跨浏览器指南，大标题是一起把网做好。课程目录在 Learn：HTML、CSS、无障碍按卡片排开。点开 Welcome to Learn Accessibility，Carie Fisher 写清 a11y 是让残障用户能同等使用，并链到 WCAG。适合补基础的人；旧仓库已归档，投稿走 issue tracker。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
